# Hans Reichenbach

*1891 – 1953 · German · [Logical positivism](../movements/logical-positivism.md)*

German philosopher of science who led in Berlin a group close to the Vienna Circle; exiled to the United States, he became one of the voices of logical empiricism, notably on space-time and probability.
